deck.caption:
Nifty opened up 170 points this morning, but South Korea's KOSPI plunged 6.5%. Does a green opening mean Indian investors are safe from global inflation?

Here is what you need to know:
• Why heavy buying in IT stocks pushed Nifty up by 170 points
• Why Asian markets tumbled 6.5% as inflation concerns escalated
• How to check if your money is over-concentrated in one sector

Save this post to avoid chasing opening-bell spikes, and share it with a friend who is building their portfolio.

Is your portfolio diversified across different sectors, or are tech stocks doing all the heavy lifting?

slides.title: Nifty Gaps Up 170 Points While Asian Markets Slide

stat_data.label: Nifty Opening Jump
stat_data.context: Nifty opened with an immediate 170-point gap up, propelled primarily by sharp gains in domestic IT stocks.

stat_data.label: South Korea's KOSPI Crash
stat_data.context: While Indian tech surged, South Korea's main index sank 6.5% as rising inflation pressures shook foreign investor sentiment.

slides.title: How One Sector Moved the Index

flowchart_data.text: Inflation concerns trigger a sharp 6.5% drop in South Korea's KOSPI.
Indian IT stocks experience concentrated buying interest at the market open.
Because IT carries high index weight, Nifty opens 170 points higher despite regional headwinds.

comparison_data.myth: A 170-point jump at the open means Indian markets are completely shielded from global inflation.
comparison_data.reality: A single-sector surge can lift the headline index temporarily, masking underlying global risks.

checklist_data.item: Check if your mutual fund or stock portfolio is heavily weighted in only IT shares.
Rushing to buy immediately on opening spikes without checking broader market sentiment.
Holding investments spread across multiple unrelated domestic sectors.

slides.title: What Remains Uncertain
slides.card_text: A strong opening does not guarantee a sustained upward trend. If global inflation continues to bite Asian peers, foreign capital flows and broader market segments can face extended volatility. Never confuse a one-day IT push with total immunity.

slides.title: Don't Let One Green Morning Mislead You
slides.cta_detail: Save this guide to review before trading on volatile opening mornings, and share with a fellow investor.
